events.title: Hormuz crisis ongoing — Iran-US exchanges continue
events.details: IRGC closed Hormuz July 12. Tanker explosions Aug 5 near Kumzar. Oil residue on Qeshm Island Aug 13. Trump claims 'complete control' Aug 12. Kushner meets regional leaders Aug 16. EIA: Brent $87 avg 2026, 0.6M b/d disruptions through end 2027. Saudi cuts Asian prices, US imports of Saudi oil at zero.

events.title: US-Japan yen intervention unraveling — JGB yields surge
events.details: Joint US-Japan intervention July 31 (~$36-59B spent). Yen erased half gains, back to ~159. US sold euros (not dollars) to avoid Treasury disruption — ECB not warned. 30Y Treasury at 5.2% (highest since 2007). JGB 2Y at 1.65% (highest since 1995), 10Y highest since 1996. BOJ pressured for more hikes. Takata dissented for 1.25% rate.

events.title: Ebola PHEIC — fastest-growing outbreak on record
events.details: DRC: 4,945 confirmed cases, 2,325 deaths (as of Aug 15). 730 hospitalized. Bundibugyo ebolavirus — existing treatments certified for Zaire species only. WHO PHEIC declared May 17. PPE shortages, healthcare worker infections. CDC warns of violence against HCWs.

events.title: China property crisis — $148B expiring lease time bomb
events.details: Bloomberg: $148B commercial real estate expiring lease threat. Office values down 40%+ from peaks. $130B developer defaults. PBOC pledges 'appropriately loose' stance Aug 12 but no explicit rate/RRR cuts. Yuan at 3.5-year high (6.79). National team reactivated for capital outflows. Foreign Affairs: next global crisis could be made in China — cascading to Pakistan, Ecuador, Zambia.

new_developments.title: ECB set to deliver final rate hike next month
new_developments.details: Reuters poll: shortest tightening drive since 2011. ECB not warned about US euro-funded yen intervention — 'shocking breakdown of central bank etiquette' (Telegraph).

new_developments.title: UK national wildfire emergency alert — 75% of England in drought
new_developments.details: Government sent national mobile emergency alert Aug 14. Worst food security crisis in decades (Guardian/Telegraph). 10Y gilts at 5.05%, 30Y at 5.7%. Starmer resigned June, Burnham now PM.

new_developments.title: South Korea proposes end-of-war talks with North
new_developments.details: President Lee Jae-myung proposed talks Aug 15. Potentially de-escalating Korean peninsula tensions.

new_developments.title: Private credit PIK distress + Dodd-Frank rollback advancing
new_developments.details: Boston Fed: growing PIK usage in private credit. House advancing Dodd-Frank rollback legislation (Aug 14). US household loan delinquencies at decade high (NY Fed Q2). IMF: US deficit 7.4% GDP through 2031.

new_developments.title: Gold at $4,395 — up 31.9% YoY
new_developments.details: Safe haven demand persisting from geopolitical tensions. Silver not spiking — no panic phase yet.

new_developments.title: Sudan civil war continues, South Africa xenophobic deportations
new_developments.details: Sudan: 20 civilians killed in Blue Nile State clashes (Aug 9). South Africa seeking deportation cost refunds from Nigeria, Malawi, Ethiopia. 83 Nigerians returning Aug 19 amid xenophobic attacks.
